parameters.description: Use lon+lat without radius_km or bbox. Return objects ordered by distance across the published catalog, without a distance cutoff. Use limit=3 for urgent scenarios; cursor continues the same nearest search.

get.description: Read-only public catalog. Exactly one search mode: lon+lat+radius_km OR bbox. Radius in km (0,20], distance_m in metres on the spheroid, not walking distance. Defaults to all supported categories. Radius results ordered by distance then place_id; bbox results by place_id. OSM availability is not verified on site; date does not filter by opening hours. Unsupported categories return 422. No mock fallback; unavailable database returns 503. Also supports lon+lat+nearest=true without radius_km or bbox: distance-ordered search without a distance cutoff.
car_duration_sec — время движения автомобиля. Не включает неизвестную подачу. Не меняет пеший план.

Подходы от исходных точек до snapped endpoints не включены. car не вызывает такси, не учитывает live traffic или подачу.

parameters.name: buffer_m
parameters.description: Maximum geodesic distance from the route in metres; default 125.

get.description: Checks trip ownership and expected_version. Searches PostGIS using the complete original OSM leg geometries as a MultiLineString, without simplification or straight connectors between legs. Default buffer is 125 m to either side and around the ends. distance_to_route_m is the shortest geodesic distance to the line, not a walking detour. All saved legs of the selected day are included. Cursor is bound to route geometry, version, date and filters; version changes return 409. No GPS centre is used.

post.summary: Карточки рекомендаций и предложение дополнить короткий день

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: Токен сессии; backend также проверяет Origin.

post.description: Loads a validated recommendation snapshot, shared by manual choices and route calculation. Preview options are scoped to its owner/version/expiry. Short day: <70% of effective time; suggestions within 2000 m of the last activity, or globally for an empty day. At most two manual choices per day, including supplements. Excludes all places already scheduled in the trip; checks real OSM paths, time and availability for supplemental candidates. Active trips cannot be supplemented yet.

Instant.description: RFC3339 с обязательным offset. Календарная зона Нижнего Europe/Moscow.

Interval.description: Полуоткрытый интервал [start_at,end_at), start_at < end_at проверяется сервером.

child_interest_weights.description: Равные нормированные веса интересов детей: сумма равна 1; для справочника без семьи массив пуст. Возрастная пригодность оценивается отдельно.

max_walk_distance_m_per_day.description: Daily family walking limit M, meters. Null selects the minimum configured age default among children; explicit value overrides the default.

restaurant_walk_reserve_m_per_day.description: Daily reserve p in meters for future restaurant detours. Must not exceed m. Primary route budget is m-p, including start and end legs. Omitted means zero. This is not meal duration or walked distance.

rest_budget_sec.description: Daily rest time reserve. Existing rest stops cover the reserve; only the unallocated remainder is added.

meal_duration_sec.description: Total daily meal time, seconds. When omitted, meal_count times the configured duration for meal_format. Explicit zero disables the meal time reserve.

planning_policy.description: manual_choices: route only explicitly selected places, with additional cards offered for short days. ranked_prefix: automatic ranked filling only when explicitly requested. Both enforce two manual choices per day. Omission preserves legacy behaviour.

address.description: Address from database; may be empty.

opening_hours_raw.description: Raw source notation; not parsed into confirmed hours.

distance_m.description: Centre-to-object geodesic distance in metres. Present only in radius search; not walking distance.

distance_to_route_m.description: Shortest geodesic distance to the saved route line in metres, not walking distance. Route-corridor search only.

child_age_fit.description: По одной оценке пригодности конкретной активности возрастной группе каждого child_id; null означает отсутствие подтверждённой оценки. Это не глобальный вес возраста. Известный возрастной запрет отражается отдельно в eligibility и не компенсируется score.

limit.description: Initial planning requests 50 ranked distinct places for the entire trip. ML does not assign days or compute routes.

candidates.description: At most limit distinct place_id values, ordered by relevance; fewer valid places are allowed. No day assignment or geometry.

availability.description: Availability snapshot used for re-planning existing stops without fetching a new ML ranking.

Leg.description: calculated требует ненулевые geometry/distance/time; unavailable требует null. Реальный путь, не прямая линия.

rest_duration_sec.description: Maximum of rest_budget_sec and scheduled rest-stop duration, without double counting.

meal_duration_sec.description: Maximum of the daily meal time reserve and scheduled meal-stop duration, without double counting.

elapsed_duration_sec.description: Before start: estimated travel, visits, waits and break reserves. After active replan: observed elapsed wall-clock time plus estimated remaining duration; historical category estimates can differ from observed time.

restaurant_walk_reserve_m.description: Reserved walking distance p, not part of actual walked distance.

primary_walk_budget_m.description: max(0, min(M, V*T_walk) - P), meters. Recalculated for candidate visits and waits.

remaining_walk_distance_m.description: Original daily M minus confirmed estimated walked distance, before planning the remaining stops.

remaining_duration_sec.description: Original available day time minus observed elapsed time, before planning remaining stops.

execution.description: Present after start_day apply. The most recently started date is the active day; previous confirmed history is immutable.

days.description: Пустой массив допустим только для draft.

oneOf.description: Insert a catalog infrastructure object as the next planned stop, preserving visited history and other days. Server resolves coordinates and estimates visit duration. With current_position on an active day, the OSM estimate from the last confirmed position is accounted separately. Returns a normal preview; user confirmation applies it.
Supported text commands: remove a named/next/last stop, shorten the route, replan. Unsupported or ambiguous requests are rejected; no LLM service is implied.

PlanPreview.description: Не изменяет сохранённую поездку. proposed_trip.version=base_version+1. Перед apply проверяются срок и версии.

ProgressRequest.description: Only the next planned stop of the active day can be confirmed. Terminal progress is immutable. Skipping requires an explicit replan preview before continuing.

walking_speed_kph.description: Только для walk; без параметра используется скорость движка, не семейная норма.

RoutingRequest.description: Координаты в bbox пилота [43.5,56.05,44.4,56.6]. Привязка к сети до 100 м. Обязательность полей и режим проверяются сервером.

DayExecution.description: Confirmed progress. Distance and category durations are estimates from confirmed planned legs/stops; elapsed is observed wall-clock time. Not GPS tracking.

password.description: 15–128 Unicode code points, up to 1024 UTF-8 bytes; spaces are preserved.

expected_version.description: 0 for first save; then the current profile version.

planning_policy.description: manual_choices: route only explicitly selected places, with additional cards offered for short days. ranked_prefix: automatic ranked filling only when explicitly requested. Both enforce two manual choices per day. Omission preserves legacy behaviour.
